name: Swish Ventures
identity_check: Swish Ventures at swish.vc, the Israeli seed / Series A fund led by former NBA player Omri Casspi; its site lists Upwind, EON, Cognition, Wonderful, Glow, Applied Compute and Long Lake. Not Swish.ai (Series A 2021) and not the Indian food-delivery startup Swish.

open_items: HQ (Israel), check size (~$20M per company for Fund III, $5-7M for Fund II), focus sectors and thesis appeared only as tool summaries of Globes / Calcalist / Ynet, not quotable verbatim; not recorded.
Lead '$60M, 2024-12-02' is Fund II (second seed fund, Calcalist timestamp 02.12.24); Calcalist says 'raised $60 million'. Only Fund III recorded as latest fund.

Only two rounds with a page naming Swish. Caplight lists Glow (Series B, Jul 2026) and Cognition AI (Series E, Sep 2026) but round pages not fetched. Upwind stage not stated in the article (later reports call it Series B); Calcalist did not label AIR as seed.
